en_title: Batman Star Ben Affleck Says Justice League Reshoots Were the Lowest Point of His Career
cn_title: 阿弗莱克痛批《正义联盟》补拍经历
subtitle: 「职业生涯最低谷」
opus_summary: 本·阿弗莱克称《正义联盟》补拍是职业生涯最低谷，并批评华纳借施奈德的家庭悲剧夺走影片主导权。这段负面经历也让他打消了执导DC宇宙电影的念头。

paragraphs.en: Batman actor Ben Affleck has slammed Warner Bros. for how they handled the production of Justice League and called the experience the lowest post of his career.
paragraphs.cn: 蝙蝠侠扮演者本·阿弗莱克痛批华纳兄弟在《正义联盟》制作过程中的处理方式，称这段经历是他职业生涯的最低谷。

paragraphs.en: When speaking on the Happy Sad Confused podcast , Affleck was asked about his canceled standalone Batman film, which would've featured Joe Manganiello as Deathstroke . The actor/director said he was excited by what he was cooking up for that Batman film, but admitted that the experience of working on Justice League turned him off to the idea of having to helm a movie in the DC universe.
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克做客播客《Happy Sad Confused》时，被问及他那部已取消的《蝙蝠侠》独立电影。该片原计划由Joe Manganiello饰演丧钟。这位演员兼导演表示，他曾对自己为这部《蝙蝠侠》电影构思的内容感到兴奋，但也承认，参与《正义联盟》的经历让他打消了执导DC宇宙电影的念头。

paragraphs.en: "The truth is, the experience of Justice League was so, so negative for lots of different reasons," said Affleck. "Some of which having to do with where I was personally, some of which having to do with the tragedy that happened during the time, and also the fact that I really saw how not to make a movie like that when the studio is at odds with the filmmaker. You're really making a mistake. That was what really doomed that."
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克说：「说实话，出于很多不同的原因，拍摄《正义联盟》的经历非常、非常糟糕。有些原因与我当时的个人状态有关，有些与那段时间发生的悲剧有关。另外，我也真切地看到了，拍这种电影时，有些做法是行不通的：制片公司不能和电影创作者对着干。那真的是个错误。真正毁掉这部电影的就是这一点。」

paragraphs.en: Affleck is referencing the fact that WB battled director Zack Snyder pretty heavily on his DC films, most notably Justice League after Batman v Superman failed to meet critical expectations. The film was also deemed a bit of a disappointment by WB for not cracking the $1 billion mark, despite featuring three of DC's biggest heroes. As a result, there was a lot of pressure on Snyder to make Justice League more appealing via a lighter tone and different story ideas.
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克指的是，华纳兄弟与导演扎克·施奈德在他的DC电影上存在相当激烈的分歧。《蝙蝠侠大战超人》的口碑未达预期后，双方在《正义联盟》上的冲突尤为突出。尽管《蝙蝠侠大战超人》集结了DC旗下最具人气的三位英雄，票房却未能突破10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)，这也让华纳兄弟有些失望。因此，施奈德承受了很大压力，需要通过更轻松的基调和不同的故事构思，让《正义联盟》更具吸引力。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, Snyder had to leave the project during post-production after his daughter took her own life. Warner Bros. then enlisted the help of Avengers director Joss Whedon to come in and direct reshoots, which massively changed the film's tone and story. The reshoots were also hampered by allegations of actors being mistreated by Whedon and other issues, which Affleck stated he was aware of second-hand. He also went on to say that he believes WB used the tragedy in Snyder's family to as an "excuse" to hijack Justice League. He noted that the experience of these reshoots was the "low point" of his career.
paragraphs.cn: 不幸的是，施奈德的女儿自杀身亡，他不得不在后期制作阶段退出项目。随后，华纳兄弟请来《复仇者联盟》导演乔斯·韦登执导补拍，大幅改变了影片的基调和故事。补拍期间还出现了演员指控韦登苛待他们等问题，阿弗莱克表示，他是从他人那里听说这些情况的。他还表示，在他看来，华纳兄弟把施奈德的家庭悲剧当作「借口」，夺走了《正义联盟》的主导权。他称，这次补拍经历是自己职业生涯的「最低谷」。

paragraphs.en: "The way in which that was, I thought frankly, used as an excuse was one of the sh**tiest things I'd ever seen," said Affleck. "It was so gross. And then the whole environment and vibe, much of which I wasn't privvy to, but that I sort of heard about second hand in terms of Ray [Fisher] and Gal [Gadot] and other peoples' experiences. It was just like 'Wow, this is about as gross as it gets.'"
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克说：「坦白说，我认为他们拿那件事当借口的做法，是我见过最混账的事情之一。太恶心了。还有当时整个环境和氛围，其中很多情况我并不知情，只是从别人那里听说了Ray［Fisher］、盖尔［加朵］和其他人的经历。我当时就觉得，哇，简直不能更恶心了。」

paragraphs.en: Affleck's experience on Justice League was also intertwined with a divorce and issues with alcoholism, leading to a turbulant time for the actor. He eventually stepped down away from the role of Batman and decided not to direct his own Batman film, instead passing the baton over to director Matt Reeves and actor Robert Pattinson. He eventually returned to the role for The Flash, as well as new scenes at the end of Zack Snyder's Justice League, a director's cut of the embattled film.
paragraphs.cn: 拍摄《正义联盟》期间，阿弗莱克还经历了离婚和酗酒问题，那是他生活中一段动荡的时期。他最终辞演蝙蝠侠，也决定不再执导自己的《蝙蝠侠》电影，将接力棒交给了导演马特·里维斯和演员罗伯特·帕丁森。后来，他在《闪电侠》中再次饰演蝙蝠侠，也参演了《扎克·施奈德版正义联盟》片尾的新增场景，后者是这部风波不断的电影的导演剪辑版。

paragraphs.en: Zack Snyder also recently stated that a former WB executive expressed regret over how everything was handled . Some hardcore fans have held out hope that maybe one day Snyder's vision will be completed with another Justice League movie, but given how chaotic and negative the experience was for everyone involved, it seems hard to imagine it actually happening.
paragraphs.cn: 扎克·施奈德最近也表示，一位华纳兄弟前高管曾对当时处理这一切的方式表达悔意。一些核心粉丝仍抱有希望，期待有一天施奈德能再拍一部《正义联盟》电影，完成他的构想。但考虑到所有参与者都经历了如此混乱、糟糕的过程，似乎很难想象这件事真的会发生。
